acceptance: `make test-docker-up-trino` and `-presto` refuse an unset or relative BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR before the engine runs.
description:
PR #4082 (batch server-engine-bulk-load-3) changed docker/trino and docker/presto compose files to mount ${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR}:${BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR}:ro with no fallback, like LakeSail and Velox. The Make guard require_data_dir_if_mounted in make/platform-tests.mk only covers lakesail and velox, so `make test-docker-up-trino` / `-presto` with BENCHBOX_DATA_DIR unset would mount an empty path instead of refusing. The fix was written and tested (12 passed) but make/platform-tests.mk was outside the batch's frozen scope, so it is held as a patch at ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/make-guard-trino-presto.patch (adds trino and presto to the guard's case list and to the two parametrized cases in tests/unit/test_makefile_docker_data_dir_guard.py).

Guardrails: linked worktree; serial PR; land after #4082.
